title: Answers how an org admin sets one OpenAI key for every member.
prompt: How do I set our org's OpenAI key once so every member's pipelines use it?

checks.blocker_name: file outside the task folder changed

judge.question: Says an org admin stores it as an org-level secret, with account.setEnv('org', ...) or in account settings, and pipelines refer to it as ${ROCKETRIDE_...}.
Warns that setEnv replaces the whole set at that level. On a server with no orgs, saying so and giving these steps also passes.
